scope: Complete native E4 activation-resident QKV with ring32 BF16 seed replication and consumer-local H960 quantization, shared Term4TRF, weightstream and fused Term/K4 F32 sums. All real preparation, typed input/output gathers, channel-scale pass and unchanged head/cache tail included. No internal NPU attribution from this whole screen.

adoption.reason: This single allocation did not show a net gain. Preserve it; root decides whether a concrete unresolved variance or implementation issue justifies another check.

further_tuning.reason: 5% is a provisional additional-tuning budget, not an adoption minimum. No tile sweep is authorized by this report.

major_research.question: Does consumer-local quantization or strided H960 weight ingress delay native/head completion? Static cost observations do not establish the limiting hardware interval; any recovery diagnosis needs a supported concrete repair question.

decisions.decision_owner: Root reviewer; these are evidence-based proposed next actions, not an automatic adoption.
